_comment: The milestone's own end-to-end proof of the Social Pillar v1 (route adapted to the shipped 4-NPC pool subset -- Krshia/Selys/gate_guard/Pisces -- and the canon [Diplomat] kit). Loads the post_tutorial_street FIXTURE (Warrior L1 at the street gate cell 1,3, honest post-onboarding state) via title Continue, so the street social content runs WITHOUT re-fighting the onboarding spar. PHASE A proves the rotating talk pools + the per-waking first-use seam: gate_guard/Selys/Krshia each play ONE pool DIALOGUE_LINE on their FIRST talk this waking and bank chatted_with_<id> + heard_gossip (climbing to the volume gate of 3); a SECOND talk to Krshia the same waking opens her real crate graph with NO second pool line (chatted_with_krshia never reaches 2 -- assert absent). PHASE B proves the persuasion gate: the watch_sergeant crate persuade (crate_talk's proven fragment) banks persuaded_someone -- the [Diplomat] identity gate. With persuaded_someone:1 AND heard_gossip:3 both banked, the walk home fights the (fixture-active) floodplains ambush (Warrior + Relc ally, met_relc from the fixture) and a sleep at the inn bed (the ONLY bed -- the return leg is mandatory) resolves diplomat.gained_by: class_gained{diplomat} + the grants-listing toast. PHASE C proves the kit reaches the player: the field hotbar re-renders 1->2 slots (charming_smile is field-tagged), and pressing its slot (2) on Erin fires [Charming Smile] -> her friendly_line toast + befriended_moments + the journal (used_skills) reveal. Fixture rng_state governs post-load (overrides --seed); seed 9 for convention.
